Gene: Gene that the resource is related to
Mouse_ID: Mouse ID if derived from a mouse line
Reporter_type: Classification of reporter system utilized, if relevant (e.g. luciferase)
Target_family: Identifier of protein family targeted by modification
Target: UniProt ID of protein being targeted by modification, whether knockout, knockdown, or conversion to reporter status
Sequence: Key sequence for CRISPR/RNAi - gRNA, siRNA, etc.
Vector_ID: Applied modifying vector ID (for presto, yeast modifications, etc.)
Mod_type: Type of genetic modification - CRISPR, reporter, RNAi
Vendor_cat: Catalog ID of vendor if cells were purchased
Vendor: Name of commercial vendor cells were obtained from, if purchased
Disease_ID: If cell is disease associated, formal, canonical id from Disease Ontology
Disease_name: If cell is disease associated, formal, canonical name
Knockout: List of gene(s) knocked out in the line, if any
CLO_ID: Cell line ontology (CLO) identifier of cell line utilized
Tissue: Tissue (NCIT canonical name) from which cells were derived
Species: Organism from which cells are derived (genus and species)
Precursor_cell: If iPS or differentiated cells, list identifier of original line from which they were derived
Type: Cell type - primary, iPS, ES, differentiated, xenograft, etc.
Name: Canonical name of cell line
Data page link: External link to published data relevant for the current Pharos page
Repository: Physical repository from which resource can be purchased
Repository page link: External link to physical and/or digital repositories containing key metadata and ordering information for the resource
